occurrences.text: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
